added.description: Bypass capacitor too far from power pin: C20 is 77.5mm from J5 pin 1 (VIN_5V). Bypass capacitors should be within 3.0mm of the power pin they're decoupling. At 77.5mm, the inductance of the trace reduces filtering effectiveness.
Power trace too narrow: Power trace on USB_D+ is only 0.15mm wide. Narrow power traces cause voltage drop and can overheat under load. For 1A at 1oz copper, traces should be at least 0.5mm wide.
